heading: Limitations
lead: The Secretary may not use the authority under this subchapter to assist in the establishment of more than eight new medical schools. Such schools shall be located in geographically dispersed areas of the United States.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1991—Pub. L. 102–40 renumbered section 5074 of this title as this section. Pub. L. 102–83 substituted “Secretary” for “Administrator”.
